activation.details: Both hotspots were serving at audit time; profiles and aliases in place.

payload.actual_result: All six profiles present and matching the documented design; live state healthy during the audit with the internal radio on 5 GHz channel 36 at 80 MHz and the USB radio on 2.4 GHz channel 11, base regulatory country active, per-connection dnsmasq serving the configured ranges and clients resolving through the advertised resolver.
payload.adverse_effects: None observed during the audit; mode switches restart the involved radios and clients must re-associate, by design.
payload.expected_result: Dual access points stable, clients served with DHCP and DNS through the documented path, modes switchable by single commands.
payload.limitations: Audited on MT7922 plus MT7921U with NetworkManager 1.58.1 only; other radios or versions untested. The suite assumes a wired uplink for NAT. Multi-day soak results and the 160 MHz mode were not part of this audit; the 160 MHz width is documented as a separate record in this knowledge base.
payload.provenance: Firsthand configuration audit on the machine running the suite, performed by the person who maintains it.

root_cause.rationale: Not applicable: this record documents a working configuration suite, not a defect; no failure was being diagnosed.

payload.test_method: Configuration audit on the live machine while both hotspots were serving: every WEB-* profile field checked against the documented design (mode ap, band, channel, shared method, never-default, WPA2 RSN/CCMP with PMF optional, permanent MAC, powersave disabled), the two running ephemeral dnsmasq instances confirmed loading the shared conf-dir drop-ins, regulatory country read back with iw, and the advertised resolver queried successfully.
